long_biography.plain_text:
Guaranteed Rate grew from Victor Ciardelli's objection to opaque mortgage pricing. In Chicago, he and an early team began publishing competitors' rates and meeting estate agents whose clients wanted clearer loan terms. That referral network helped the lender establish itself locally before it expanded across the country. Ciardelli later paired the lending operation with digital application and closing systems, shifting parts of the process online.

The company also built mortgage ventures with major residential brokerages, including one with Realogy, now Anywhere. Ciardelli has retained group-wide leadership while appointing presidents to individual Rate businesses. The group's software now serves both borrowers and loan officers, including digital applications and a mobile sales tool.
